name: Django HTML-escaping bypass (format_html / HttpResponse)
attack_scenario: username = "" is echoed live into the page; it runs under the site origin in every viewer's browser and exfiltrates their session cookie.
negative_test_hint: submit username = "" and assert the response HTML-escapes it rather than reflecting it as live markup

exemplar.explanation: format_html() only escapes the values passed as its positional/keyword args — it trusts the format string itself. Pre-building that string with an f-string, %, +, or .format() smuggles unescaped user data past the escaping and returns a SafeString; passing data as args, as in format_html('{}', value), keeps it escaped. HttpResponse defaults to Content-Type text/html, so concatenating user input into its body is reflected XSS; rendering through a template keeps auto-escaping on.
